# Release highlights

Write a few short highlights describing user-visible changes. Include migration actions or material limitations when needed. State only the platforms, package choices and signing disposition actually verified for that release.

After the repository is published, end the notes with a link to the master `CHANGELOG.md` at the exact release tag. Replace the repository and tag placeholders before publication.

```markdown
Full details: [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/OWNER/REPOSITORY/blob/TAG/CHANGELOG.md).
```
